integrity: The claim is derived directly from the published channel formulas; finite numerical checks are corroborative only, and no independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the explicit \(\alpha\)-center in Theorem 7.3(i)–(ii) of the inspected open version for \(\beta>0\); it does not re-prove the source's Jacobi spectral theorem.
The line \(\beta=2\sqrt2\) is singular: for \(|\gamma|>0\) there is no finite \(\mu_j=1\) crossing, while for \(\gamma=0\) one channel is identically critical.
The publisher chapter was located bibliographically but not inspected at statement level; a silent correction there remains a residual literature risk.
title: Corrected off-diagonal critical hypersurface for the general-contact Smilansky–Solomyak model
